references.text: The question of where one should go to find life directly answers the Psalms' expression that God is the source of life and that it is with Him one finds the light of life.
The Psalms' confession that God is all for the author, even though flesh and heart fail, mirrors Peter's statement that only in Jesus are found the words of eternal life.
Moses urges the people to choose life by holding fast to the Lord, a theme resumed when Peter chooses to remain with Jesus who has the words of eternal life.
Jesus' own definition of eternal life as knowing the true God and Jesus Christ is the theological explanation for Peter's claim that Jesus has the words of eternal life.
Jesus' earlier statement that the Scriptures testify about Him and that people do not come to Him to have life, underscores Peter's recognition that only in Jesus are found the words of life.
